title: Engineer II - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
  
  
Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.
  
  
This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

* Develop production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* You'll work on connectors from design through deployment and production support, with guidance from senior team members on architecture and complex integration decisions, while contributing to platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines) that all connectors depend on.
* Research and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio
* Develop connectors and contribute to platform services, working with authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys) at both the connector and platform layer.
* Contribute to automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines that ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments.
* Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, working with senior engineers on incident resolution across our fleet of Falcon environments.
* Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.

****What You'll Need:****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience
* 4+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software products/systems, preferably in a SaaS delivery model.
* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably in Python or Go
* Experience building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases
* Hands-on experience with distributed system architecture, scalability and availability
* Strong debugging skills
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Experience operating services in production environments

**Role Overview**
The Senior Associate – Generative AI Developer will design, develop, and rigorously test end-to-end Generative AI and agentic AI applications. This role requires hands-on expertise with LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and multi-agent frameworks, combined with a disciplined approach to
**testing, performance monitoring, and optimization**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* LLM & GenAI Development: Design, develop, and maintain LLM-powered applications using APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Cohere. Implement core GenAI workflows including summarization, classification, Q&A, and content generation.
* Agentic AI Implementation: Build and orchestrate multi-agent systems using frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or Azure AI Agent Framework. Implement inter-agent communication, task routing, and tool orchestration for complex workflows.
* RAG & Embedding Pipelines: Implement retrieval-augmented generation pipelines involving embedding creation, chunking, and vector indexing using FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, or Milvus. Ensure efficient retrieval for context-aware outputs.
* Prompt Engineering & Techniques: Apply advanced prompting strategies such as Few-Shot Learning, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, and CART to improve reliability and interpretability of model responses.
* Testing & Validation: Establish automated and manual testing pipelines using TruLens, LangSmith, PromptLayer, or DeepEval to evaluate model quality, accuracy, safety, and factual grounding. Define and track metrics such as coherence, hallucination rate, and response diversity.

* Data Analysis & Preparation: Conduct EDA and pre-processing of textual datasets to ensure quality input for training, evaluation, and fine-tuning tasks.
* Documentation & Collaboration: Create detailed design documents, maintain experiment logs, and collaborate with architects, data scientists, UI/UX engineers, and product managers to ensure solution alignment with business goals.

* Strong analytical mindset, documentation discipline, and collaborative approach

As a Supplier Performance Management Analyst, you will provide data, analysis and workflow support to improve supplier performance across bp's global Asset Management supplier portfolio. Reporting to the Supplier Performance Management Delivery Lead and operating as part of a global BTC SPM team supporting in-market stakeholders, you will produce supplier scorecards and insights, monitor performance and exceptions, support governance activities and implement standardised SPM workflows, and contribute to supplier segmentation and performance improvement initiatives, with the level of BTC support varying by supplier tier.
  
  
You will also support the development of supplier contingency plans and help ensure consistent supplier performance across the portfolio. Support will range from analytical and governance activities for strategic suppliers to more end-to-end monitoring, workflow execution and exception management for moderate and tail suppliers.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Produce accurate supplier Key performance indicators reports, scorecards and dashboards, validating performance data and monitoring supplier performance against agreed KPI's and SLAs through analysis of approved performance dashboards, CMMS data, supplier portals and other maintenance / supplier-performance applications.

* Manage assigned workflows, including onboarding/offboarding, supporting Contractor Due Diligence through evidence collection, standardised diligence checks, coordination with suppliers and business collaborators, data validation, monitoring, exception triage and advancing when defined market-intervention triggers are met.
* Trends and recurring issues to identify performance risks, improvement opportunities and potential rationalisation candidates.
* Maintain supplier issue and corrective-action records, ensuring evidence, status and closure information are complete, current and auditable.
* Support supplier segmentation and re-tiering by maintaining relevant supplier data, applying approved tiering criteria and documented market-specific policy, compliance and regulatory requirements where relevant, and identifying cases requiring review or exception handling.
* Support supplier governance activities and performance reviews through preparation of performance materials, action tracking, follow-up activities and defined supplier engagement where required.

title: Workforce Analytics Analyst
description:
Title- Workforce Analytics Analyst

Work model-Work from office (5days a week)

Workforce Analytics Analyst – Resource Management Group

Role Overview

We are looking for a Workforce Analytics Analyst to support the Resource Management Group through

workforce reporting, analytics, and automation.

The role will involve working with workforce data such as utilization, bench, demand, deployment, capacity,

headcount, and hiring fulfilment, and converting this data into meaningful reports and dashboards for

business and leadership teams.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Advanced Excel, VBA/Macros, and Power

BI, along with a good understanding of workforce or resource management metrics.

MIS & Utilization Reporting Focus

A key part of this role is owning the MIS and utilization reporting for the Resource Management Group. The candidate should be able to prepare accurate utilization reports from scratch, covering billable, non-billable and bench hours at the employee, project, practice and account level. Beyond preparing the reports, the candidate should use analytics to make them sharper: spotting gaps and data mismatches (for example, between timesheets, allocation records and HRMS data), flagging low-utilization pockets, long-bench cases and delayed deployments, and pointing out where utilization can be improved. The aim is to move the reports from simply showing numbers to explaining what is driving them and what action the business should take.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and own weekly and monthly utilization reports (billable, non-billable and bench) at employee, project, practice and account level.
* Reconcile utilization data across, allocation and RMG Reports, and fix gaps and mismatches before reports are shared.
* Use analytics to find the reasons behind utilization trends and recommend actions to improve them.
* Maintain and analyse workforce data covering utilization, bench, demand, deployment, capacity headcount, and fulfilment.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc workforce reports for business and leadership reviews.
* Develop and automate Excel-based reports, trackers, and dashboards using Advanced Excel,
* VBA/Macros, Power Query, and Power Pivot.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and basic DAX calculations for workforce and business reporting.

• Identify trends, gaps, and exceptions in workforce data and provide actionable insights.

• Support analysis of the business and revenue impact of utilization, bench, delayed deployment, and

open demand.

• Work closely with Resource Management, Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, Delivery, and Business

teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting.

• Identify opportunities to simplify and automate existing reporting and MIS processes.

Required Skills

* Proven hands-on experience preparing utilization reports and RMG/MIS reports, preferably in an IT Services company.
* Ability to explain utilization numbers and insights clearly to business and leadership teams.
* 3 Plus years of relevant experience in Workforce Analytics, Resource Management, MIS, BusinessAnalytics, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Advanced Excel.
* Good working knowledge of VBA/Macros, Power Query, Power Pivot, Pivot Tables, and advanced Excelformulas.
* Hands-on experience in Power BI dashboard development.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of DAX and data modelling.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy.
* Ability to work with large datasets and present insights in a clear, business-friendly manner.
* Experience in an IT Services environment and familiarity with metrics such as utilization, bench,demand, deployment, and fulfilment would be an advantage.

title: FinCrime Data Analyst Lead
description:
Join us as a FinCrime Agile Data Analyst - VP at Barclays, where you will act as the Data Analytics Lead for Financial Crime Agile Testing. You will oversee data analytics work performed within the Agile Testing team and define the analytical testing approach for individual reviews. Working in partnership with Agile Testing colleagues, you will translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, provide input to review scope, and determine data requirements and analytical design. You will quality-control analytical scripts and outputs, communicate data-led findings and observations to stakeholders, and act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts. Through independent judgement, technical assurance and constructive challenge, you will help deliver timely, risk-based and hypothesis-led testing of Financial Crime processes and controls.
  
  
Purpose of the Role
  
  
To oversee and lead the data analytics work supporting Financial Crime Agile Testing reviews. The role determines the overall data analytics approach, defines executable analytical objectives, hypotheses and testing plans for individual reviews, provides quality control over analytical scripts and outputs, and translates data into testable insight that supports assessment of the operational effectiveness of Financial Crime controls.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
  

* Oversee data analytics work performed within the Financial Crime Agile Testing team, including defining the data analytics testing strategy required for individual reviews.
* Translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, providing data-led input to scoping decisions in collaboration with non-Data Analytics review colleagues.
* Provide leadership and technical oversight for the development of analytical test objectives, methodologies and scripts using SQL, Python and SAS; review and approve analytical work to support robust and reproducible testing outcomes.
* Identify and agree data needs and analytical design with the Agile Testing Lead during review planning and test-plan development.
* Coordinate delivery of analytics with the Agile Testing Lead during testing execution, while Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts design scripts, source data and perform analysis.
* Perform quality-control reviews of analytical scripts, including SQL, SAS and Python, designed by Data Analytics Specialists and/or Data Analytics Analysts, challenging logic, assumptions, data quality, caveats and the sufficiency of analytical evidence.
* Review analytical outputs and workpaper content to support clear, accurate and reproducible documentation of the testing performed, evidence obtained and conclusions supported by the analysis.
* Interpret and communicate findings and observations arising from data analytics testing to external stakeholders and provide analytical insight and draft input to review conclusions and reporting.
* Act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, addressing analytical judgement matters within authority and escalating material risk, scope, timeline or stakeholder issues where appropriate.
* Work alongside the Agile Testing Lead as part of stage-gate oversight and peer cross-review, preserving independent challenge and clear accountability between Testing and Data Analytics roles.
* Support the ongoing review and improvement of data analytics requirements within the Agile Testing methodology and contribute to efficient, risk-based and hypothesis-led review delivery.
* Maintain independence and objectivity, ensure timely escalation, secure evidence retention, data-privacy compliance and high-quality documentation across data analytics work.

Stakeholder Management and Leadership
  
  
The role requires strong engagement across business teams and larger FinCrime Agile testing team. The VP determines the overall data analytics approach and analytical scoping decisions for individual reviews. The role exercises independent judgement when setting analytical hypotheses and approaches, reviews work completed by Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, and acts as their escalation route. The role also contributes to the strategic development of the Financial Crime Agile Testing analytics capability and adoption of improved tools and techniques
  
  
**Basic / Essential Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading data analytics work in Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Assurance or another control-testing environment.
* Strong SQL and Python capability, including the ability to review and challenge analytical scripts, logic, assumptions and outputs developed by others.
* Experience translating risk or review triggers into analytical objectives, hypotheses, testing plans, data requirements and executable analytical approaches.
* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes, risks and controls across relevant domains such as AML, Sanctions, Customer Due Diligence/KYC, Fraud or Transaction Monitoring.
* Experience applying data analytics to assess control effectiveness using full-population or targeted testing approaches.
* Strong technical assurance, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify data-quality issues, anomalies, control weaknesses, caveats and limitations.
* Experience reviewing analytical evidence and workpapers to determine whether testing outputs sufficiently support observations and conclusions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, collaboration and constructive-challenge skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgement and escalate appropriately.
* Ability to coordinate analytical delivery, provide technical guidance and act as an escalation point for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts.

Desirable Skillsets
  
  
  

* Experience contributing to Financial Crime assurance or Agile Testing methodology and improving analytical testing standards or ways of working.
* Experience with SAS, data visualisation tools such as Tableau, statistical analysis, data mining or AI-enabled analytics.
* Experience developing reusable analytical assets or automated testing approaches that improve testing efficiency, consistency or coverage.
* Knowledge of advanced statistical or machine-learning techniques used to identify patterns, trends and relationships in data.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud services, LLM architectures, including responsible AI principles and appropriate solution validation.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, including technical assurance, critical thinking, Financial Crime risk and control analysis, root-cause analysis, systems proficiency, stakeholder engagement, collaboration and data analytics using SQL and Python, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
Role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Procurement Risk Analyst
description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. * Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
* Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
* Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
* Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
* Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
* Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.

* Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
* Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.

* Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
* Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
* Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

* Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
* Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
* Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.

Roboyo has built a unified, global data platform on Microsoft Fabric, with a medallion-architecture single source of truth for Finance, Operations, HR and other business functions; and a Power BI corporate reporting layer to steer the business.

As a
**Data Quality Specialist (f/m/d)**

**Support Driving Data Quality Strategy & Governance**

* Engage with Data Domain Managers, Data Stewards, and business stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into measurable Data Quality controls.
* Act as a trusted advisor for defining Data Quality expectations and remediation approaches.
* Support the adoption of Data Quality best practices across enterprise data domains.

**Data Profiling, Monitoring & Analysis**

* Perform data profiling and analysis to identify data quality issues and improvement opportunities.
* Drive root cause analysis and support remediation activities to improve data reliability and consistency.
* Develop and monitor Data Quality KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Collibra Data Quality & Observability**

* Serve as a key contributor to the implementation, adoption, and optimization of Collibra Data Quality & Observability.
* Design, implement, test, and monitor business and technical Data Quality rules.

* Define and monitor Data Quality requirements for Data Products, ensuring data is fit for business, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Improve transparency and accountability through measurable service expectations and monitoring practices.

**Semantic-Driven Data Quality**

* Leverage metadata, business glossaries, and semantic definitions to improve Data Quality rule design and reuse.
* Strengthen alignment between business concepts, data assets, and Data Quality controls.
* Support scalable approaches to Data Quality management across enterprise data environments.

**Automation & Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to automate Data Quality activities including:

+ Data profiling
+ Rule generation
+ Monitoring
+ Issue detection
+ Data cleansing and remediation

* Explore and apply AI-enabled approaches such as anomaly detection, rule discovery, automated issue analysis, and intelligent remediation.

**Data Platforms & Analytics**

* Utilize SQL and modern data management practices to analyze, profile, and monitor enterprise data assets.
* Support data teams in maintaining trusted data pipelines and quality standards.

**Training & Enablement**

* Create and maintain training materials, templates, standards, and guidance documentation.
* Enable Data Domains to independently manage and improve Data Quality.
* Present methodologies, project outcomes, and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Management, and AI.
* Recommend and implement innovative solutions that increase the effectiveness, scalability, and maturity of Data Quality capabilities.

**Education**

* MBA from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad.
* Additional qualifications in Data Management, Governance, Analytics, or Technology are advantageous.

**Professional Experience**

* 7 to 8 years of professional experience in:

+ Data Quality Management
+ Data Governance
+ Data Management
+ Data Analytics
+ Related enterprise data disciplines

**Technical Skills**
Strong expertise in:
  
  

* Data profiling and analysis
* SQL and data querying
* Data Quality rule creation and implementation
* Data Quality monitoring and issue management
* Root cause analysis and remediation processes

Hands-on experience with:
  
  

* Collibra Data Quality & Observability
* Collibra Data Catalog
* Metadata Management solutions

Strong working knowledge of:
  
  

* Snowflake
* Modern cloud data architectures
* Enterprise data platforms

**Data Governance Expertise**
Good understanding of:
  
  

* Data Contracts
* Data Product Quality
* Data Ownership frameworks
* Metadata Management
* Data Asset Management
* Enterprise Data Modeling

Understanding of semantic-driven Data Quality approaches and the relationship between business concepts, metadata, and Data Quality controls.
  
  
**Automation & AI**
Experience identifying and implementing automation opportunities across the Data Quality lifecycle.
  
  
Exposure to AI-enabled capabilities such as:
  
  

* Rule discovery
* Anomaly detection
* Automated issue identification
* Intelligent remediation
* Data Quality automation

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Proven ability to translate business requirements into measurable Data Quality controls.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
* Experience collaborating with both technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional environments.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP or enterprise ERP environments is advantageous.
* Experience developing Data Quality dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting solutions is highly desirable.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning.
* Collaborative and proactive approach to driving change.

**Language Skills**

* C2-level spoken and written English.
* German language skills are considered a plus.

**About The Team**
The
**Data Governance**
organization at Siemens Energy enables trusted, well-managed, and fit-for-purpose data across the enterprise. Our mission is to establish clear accountability for data while providing the frameworks, standards, capabilities, and tools that help the business understand, manage, and continuously improve its data assets.
  
  
Within Data Governance, the
**Data Quality**
capability works closely with Data Domains, Data Stewards, and governance stakeholders to make data quality measurable, transparent, and actionable. By combining business ownership, governance practices, and modern technology platforms, we ensure critical enterprise data can be trusted for operational processes, analytics, reporting, and AI-driven decision-making.
  
  
As part of our team, you will join a collaborative and international environment where you will help strengthen enterprise Data Quality capabilities, enable stakeholders through training and knowledge sharing, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of Data Governance across Siemens Energy.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With around 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future and support the reliable, sustainable, and affordable supply of energy worldwide.
  
  
Our technologies support the global energy transition through solutions in power generation, transmission, storage, grid technologies, and industrial decarbonization. Built on more than 150 years of innovation, Siemens Energy continues to shape the future of energy while helping customers achieve their sustainability goals.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character, regardless of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
  
  
We energize society, all of society, and do not discriminate based on our differences. We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

(Pune)

*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud-based procurement solutions.*

At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

  

**CONTEXT**:

You will be part of the Professional Services Team whose mission is to successfully deliver our unique and configurable solution to customers and support our Partner community with high quality standards and a strong commitment to excellence and efficiency. Our team is very hands-on with a strong mindset of problem-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end-to-end spend management data solutions.

  

**ROLE**:

We are seeking a highly technical, handson, and detailoriented Principal Integration professional to lead the **most complex, handson integration designs and builds** across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing missioncritical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.

You will act as the goto integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).

This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US**

  

**Integration Design & Implementation**

* *EndtoEnd Integration Design:* Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other thirdparty systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* *HandsOn Build:* Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, filebased interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highestcomplexity streams.
* *Standards & Reuse:* Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* *Performance & Robustness:* Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* *Troubleshooting & Debugging:* Act as the toplevel technical escalation point for integrationrelated incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, golive and hypercare phases.

  

**CrossFunctional Collaboration**

* *Work with Functional & Technical Teams:* Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* *Customer Technical Workshops:* Lead or colead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* *R&D Feedback:* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* *PreSales Support:* Provide technical input on the most complex or highrisk proposals contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to derisk the deal.

  

**Delivery Excellence**

* *Technical Specifications:* Produce highquality, referencestandard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* *Quality Assurance:* Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* *Risk & Issue Management:* Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* *Lifecycle Support:* Support cutover planning, golive readiness, and postgolive stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and earlylife support for the most critical engagements.

  

**Partner & Internal Enablement**

* *Technical Mentor:* Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* *Partner Guidance:* Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* *Knowledge Assets:* Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, howto guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.

**YOUR PROFILE**

If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:

  

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or webbased software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant handson experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, APIbased, filebased) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve most the complex integration problems across applications, middleware, and databases.
* Strong analytical and problemsolving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and longterm maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .
* Comfortable working in a customerfacing Professional Services or consulting environment, managing multiple workstreams and priorities.
* A Bachelor's (BS) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field or foreign equivalent is required.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed (~10-20%, depending on project needs).

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with or alongside Systems Integrators (SIs) or consulting partners on integration topics.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and integration services (iPaaS, API gateways, message queues, eventdriven architectures).
* Familiarity with using automation or AIassisted tools for mapping, testing, or monitoring integrations.

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

description:
**Job Summary**
Synechron is seeking a Business Analyst to support the design, integration, and optimization of enterprise payment clearing systems.
  
  
The role will translate business requirements into payment flows, functional specifications, user stories, data mappings, and clearing workflows. The position will contribute to accurate, compliant, and efficient processing across domestic, cross-border, wire, ACH, real-time, instant, and SWIFT payment rails.
  
  
Software Requirements
  
  
**Required**

* JIRA and Confluence: Experience supporting Agile/Scrum delivery and maintaining requirements documentation.
* Postman: Experience testing and validating payment APIs.
* SQL: Ability to query and analyze payment, transaction, and reconciliation data.
* ISO 20022: Practical experience with XML message structures, mapping, validation, and compliance.
* API and message mapping tools: Experience documenting request, response, transformation, and routing rules.
* Payment processing platforms: Experience with payment hubs, orchestration layers, or clearing engines.

**Preferred**

* NoSQL databases and document-based data analysis
* Payment monitoring, reconciliation, and operational reporting tools
* Process mapping and modeling tools
* Knowledge of automated API and message validation tools

Overall Responsibilities
  
  

* Gather requirements and convert business objectives into functional specifications and user stories.
* Design end-to-end payment flows across ACH, Fedwire, CHIPS, SEPA, instant payments, and SWIFT.
* Define clearing cycles, cut-off times, settlement processes, routing rules, and exception handling.
* Create data-mapping documents for legacy formats, ISO 20022 XML, API messages, and related payment standards.
* Configure and document domestic and cross-border payment rules.
* Define workflows for returns, rejects, investigations, repairs, and reconciliation.
* Support integration with sanctions screening, AML, KYC, and fraud prevention controls.
* Work with technology teams to validate payment processing, ledger posting, and liquidity management requirements.
* Review delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business outcomes.
* Maintain accurate documentation of payment rules, flows, mappings, and operational procedures.

**Expected outcomes:**

* Accurate and complete payment requirements and mappings
* Correct routing across applicable clearing systems
* Improved processing accuracy and exception management
* Support for ISO 20022 compliance and regulatory requirements
* Reduced payment failures, manual repairs, and processing delays

**Technical Skills (By Category)**
Programming and Scripting
  
  
**Essential:**

* Ability to read and validate API payloads, XML, JSON, and payment messages
* Basic scripting or query skills for data analysis and validation

**Preferred:**

* Python or another scripting language for payment data analysis
* Experience with automated message validation

Databases and Data Management
  
  
**Essential:**

* SQL for transaction and payment data analysis
* Understanding of relational data structures, transaction status, and reconciliation data
* Experience mapping legacy payment formats to ISO 20022 messages
* Knowledge of ledger posting and data integrity requirements

**Preferred:**

* NoSQL data structures
* Data lineage, reporting, and payment reconciliation tools

Cloud Technologies
  
  
**Essential:**

* Understanding of enterprise payment platforms deployed in hosted or cloud environments
* Awareness of availability, resilience, security, and operational requirements

**Preferred:**

* Experience with cloud-based payment hubs, APIs, or integration platforms

Frameworks and Libraries
  
  
**Essential:**

* ISO 20022 message standards
* SWIFT MT and MX message formats
* REST API concepts
* Payment orchestration and integration patterns
* Clearing and settlement workflow design

**Preferred:**

* Event-driven payment processing
* Messaging and queue-based integration
* Process modeling frameworks

Development Tools and Methodologies
  
  
**Essential:**

* Agile/Scrum delivery
* JIRA and Confluence
* Postman for API testing
* Requirements traceability and acceptance criteria
* Functional testing and defect management
* Process and workflow documentation

**Preferred:**

* Behavior-driven development
* Automated regression testing
* Continuous integration and delivery concepts

Security and Compliance
  
  
**Essential:**

* Sanctions screening, AML, KYC, and fraud prevention controls
* Payment data security and access-control principles
* Understanding of audit trails, data privacy, and regulatory reporting
* Secure handling of payment messages and customer information

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting compliance assessments or control testing
* Knowledge of risk-based payment monitoring

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–10 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Payment Systems Analyst, Product Analyst, or related role.
* Practical experience designing payment flows and integrating domestic and international payment rails.
* Experience with ACH, wire payments, real-time or instant payments, and SWIFT.
* Experience with ISO 20022 compliance, message mapping, API messages, and routing rules.
* Experience designing clearing, settlement, returns, rejections, exception, and reconciliation processes.
* Experience working with payment hubs, orchestration layers, ledger systems, or clearing engines.
* Banking, financial services, payments, or regulated financial technology experience is required.
* Equivalent experience gained through progressive payment operations, implementation, testing, or product delivery roles may be considered.

Day-to-Day Activities
  
  

* Review business requirements, payment rules, operational procedures, and regulatory needs.
* Document payment flows, clearing cycles, cut-off times, routing logic, and settlement requirements.
* Prepare user stories, functional specifications, process diagrams, and acceptance criteria.
* Build and review ISO 20022, API, and legacy-format mapping documents.
* Test APIs and payment messages using Postman and other approved tools.
* Analyze transaction data using SQL to identify processing issues and exceptions.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, operations, compliance, and risk teams.
* Participate in Scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and planning sessions.
* Support defect triage, user acceptance testing, implementation activities, and production issue analysis.
* Recommend improvements to payment workflows, controls, routing, and exception handling.

**Decision-making responsibilities include:**

* Clarifying functional requirements and payment processing rules.
* Recommending workflow, mapping, and routing options.
* Identifying impacts, dependencies, and operational risks.
* Escalating issues related to compliance, settlement, liquidity, data integrity, or customer impact.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Certifications in business analysis, Agile delivery, payments, or financial services are preferred.
* Training in ISO 20022, payment operations, API testing, AML, sanctions screening, and financial crime controls is beneficial.
* Ongoing learning is expected in payment standards, clearing systems, regulatory requirements, and digital payment technologies.

Professional Competencies
  
  

* Critical thinking: Analyze payment flows, dependencies, exceptions, and impacts using documented evidence.
* Problem-solving: Identify root causes and recommend practical improvements to payment processing.
* Leadership and teamwork: Coordinate effectively across business, technology, operations, compliance, and testing teams.
* Communication: Explain payment requirements, data mappings, and processing rules clearly.
* Stakeholder management: Build alignment among stakeholders with different operational and technical priorities.
* Adaptability: Learn new payment rails, message standards, regulations, and platform capabilities.
* Innovation: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve automation, and reduce manual intervention.
* Time management: Prioritize work based on regulatory deadlines, payment cut-offs, delivery commitments, and business impact.
* Sustainable delivery: Promote reusable documentation, efficient processes, reduced rework, and solutions that minimize unnecessary operational effort.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as
**“**
AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
**”**
at Barclays, where you’ll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You’ll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance & optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance & optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance & optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**About Purplle & Our Mission**
Purplle is more than a beauty e-commerce destination; we are a technology-first platform redefining how digital scale is managed. We are currently in a transformative phase, moving from “manual intervention and firefighting” to an era of Systematic Resilience.
  
  
Our mission is to build “Unbreakable Systems”—platforms that don’t just survive failures but absorb them, self-heal, and scale with the business calmly and predictably. We are looking for engineers who want to stop “fixing” and start “architecting” at the highest level.
  
  
THE PURPLLE WAY: AI-NATIVE ENGINEERING
  
  
We Believe That As a Business Scales, Technology Shouldn’t Become More Fragile. We Have Redesigned Our Entire Engineering Lifecycle To Be AI-native, Moving Away From Manual Toil Toward a World Of Intelligent, Self-governing Systems
  
  

* Velocity without Fear (70% AI-Assisted): We ship fast because we’ve built the safety nets to do so. You won’t just be a “coder”; you will be a system architect. We empower our engineers to use AI for the heavy lifting of development—aiming for 70% of Pull Requests to be AI-assisted—so you can focus on complex logic and high-level architecture.
* Built-in Guardrails & Self-Healing Systems: Security and quality aren’t “extra steps”—they are baked into our “Golden Paths.” We build systems that use AI for automated rollbacks and deterministic fallback logic, ensuring the platform absorbs mistakes automatically and remains resilient under pressure.
* Intelligence by Default (Zero-Toil Operations): We embed AI across the entire lifecycle—Build,Test, Detect, and Operate. By utilizing AI agents to eliminate “Ops Toil,” we’ve created an environment where anomaly detection and incident diagnosis happen in minutes, not hours.
* Predictable Economics & Growth: We treat cloud costs and system performance as core engineering disciplines. Every engineer at Purplle understands the “unit economics” of their code, ensuring our infrastructure scales as efficiently as our business.

THE PURPLLE ENGINEER: MINDSET & IMPACT
  
  
We Aren’t Looking For “feature Factories”; We Are Looking For Owners Of a Resilient Ecosystem. At Purplle, Your Success Is Defined By Your Mindset And The Tangible Impact You Have On Our Platform
  
  
The Systems Thinker (Quality & Resilience): You hate fixing the same bug twice. You’d rather build a “self-healing” mechanism than perform a manual fix. Your goal is to maintain a Change Failure Rate of <1.5% and help us reach a state of fewer than 2 Sev-1 incidents per quarter. The AI-Fluent Architect (High Velocity): You are already using AI tools to 10x your own productivity. You leverage these tools to drive a cycle time of <4 hours and maintain a high frequency of dailydeployments, moving code from commit to production with total confidence.- The Data-Informed Engineer (Economic Discipline): You care about the “why” behind the code. You understand that latency and cloud spend are engineering disciplines, and you optimize your infrastructure so that our cost-per-order remains predictable as we scale.
- The Proactive Collaborator (Security & Governance): You thrive in a cross-functional environment (Eng, Data, DevOps, Security). You take ownership of the “Golden Path,” ensuring 100% of your repositories are gated and that zero critical vulnerabilities ever reach our production environment.
YOUR SPECIFIC MANDATE
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be Directly Responsible For**

* AI-Native Velocity: Lead the 70% AI-assisted PR mandate by mastering Cursor, Copilot, and Claude to accelerate delivery of Node.js (NestJS) and Golang microservices—while keeping human intelligence focused on high-level system design and architecture decisions.
* Unbreakable Backend Architecture: Architect high-throughput, event-driven microservices using Kafka and Redis, embedding resilience patterns like circuit breakers, health checks, and fallback mechanisms to handle massive traffic spikes without manual intervention.
* Data & Performance Ownership: Own the ‘unit economics’ of the data layer—optimize MySQL and MongoDB queries, design efficient schemas, and ensure sub-second p99 latencies with predictable infrastructure costs on GCP.
* End-to-End Golden Path Ownership: Drive features from design docs to Kubernetes deployment, ensuring high reliability through strong engineering practices and maintaining low change failure rates and minimal Sev-1 incidents.
* API & Service Design Excellence: Build clean, versioned, and backward-compatible APIs and modular microservices with a strong focus on maintainability, scalability, and clear service contracts.
* Cloud-Native Operations & Observability: Design and operate services on Kubernetes with robust logging, monitoring, and alerting; proactively debug production issues and ensure high availability.
* Scalability & Cost Efficiency: Continuously optimize system throughput, fault tolerance, and infrastructure utilization to support high growth while maintaining strict control over cloud costs.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead design decisions, write clear RFCs, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and DevOps teams to drive high-quality outcomes.
* Core Engineering Excellence: Apply strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, and data structures, combined with sharp problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

TECH STACK
  
  

* Languages & Frameworks: Node.js (NestJS / Express), Golang
* Data & Messaging: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Aerospike, ElasticSearch
* Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GCP / AWS, Docker
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
* AI Productivity: Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot

**Experience**

* SDE1 — 1–2 years of backend engineering experience
* SDE2 — 2–5 years; strong ownership of production systems
* SDE3 — 5–7 years; proven track record of designing distributed systems at scale

WHY JOIN PURPLLE TECH?
  
  
You will be joining a team that is actively moving away from the “chaos” of traditional scaling. At Purplle, we are building a tech culture that is “Operational, not Aspirational.”
  
  
We provide the tools, the AI-first environment, and the “Golden Paths” to let you do the best work of your career. If you want to build intelligent, unbreakable systems that scale with confidence, your journey starts here.

You will work within an autonomous team covering end-to-end delivery—from architectural design to containerized deployment and production troubleshooting.

Architecture & Solutions Engineering
  
  

* Core Domain Development: Architect and implement Predictive, Progressive, and Preview outbound systems using Go-based microservices and API-first design.
* Management & Admin Interfaces: Develop configuration and administration management interfaces built on Node.js.
* Frontend Engineering: Build responsive, high-performance web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript alongside React or Angular frameworks.
* Backend Systems: Design, build, and deploy enterprise microservices capable of handling high TPS with ultra-low latency, high resiliency, and scalability.

Technical Leadership & Quality Focus
  
  

* Domain SME: Serve as a domain Subject Matter Expert (SME), drive key architecture decisions, and perform rigorous code reviews across Agile/Scrum teams.

* AI Integration: Utilize AI coding assistants (e.g., Codex, Cursor, Claude) and prompt engineering to optimize workflows across assessment, planning, code generation, testing, and deployment.

Operations & Observability
  
  

* DevOps & Delivery: Operate within a self-sufficient team handling containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm (Argo CD experience is a plus).
* Observability & Incident Management: Debug complex production issues, conduct root-cause analysis (RCA), and maintain operational reliability using Grafana, Prometheus, and telemetry tools.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Education: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / M.C.A. in Computer Science or an equivalent technical field.
* Total Experience: 12+ years of overall experience architecting, designing, developing, deploying, and troubleshooting cloud API-based microservices (Cloud Native & Hybrid) and frontends.
* Backend Expertise: 10+ years of core backend engineering experience.
* Full-Stack Expertise: 5+ years of full-stack web application development experience.
* AI SDLC Practices: 1+ years utilizing AI Agents & Skills for planning, code generation, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Technical Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Backend: Strong proficiency in Go, Java, or Node.js.
* Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, and SDKs.
* Databases & Streaming: Kafka, Redis, MariaDB / MySQL.
* Architecture: Microservices architecture, distributed systems design, and RESTful APIs.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous delivery patterns (Argo CD preferred).
* Domain Expertise: Strong background in Telecommunications or Contact Centers (Outbound Contact Center background preferred).

12+ Years of Experience
